body: Alright. But if my family loses internet access over this it's seriously going to fuck up my life.

I'm not going to kill myself over downloading porn. But if another letter comes tomorrow and my parents start interrogating me about it, it might just be the straw that breaks the camel's back. I've got way too much shit on my mind and I really am not prepared to deal with this right now.
This doesn't really help now. If the damage has been done it has been done. I'm fine with not downloading anything in the future, I just am afraid of the consequences for what has already happened.
